aliases._note: retired ids from before the first 2026-10-18 renumbering -> current ids. Removed models (old model-5; exact-1..4, 8, 11, 15, 16) have no alias and fall back to the first model. Ids are stable: the second renumbering (old Model 5, 6, 7, 9, 10, 12, 13, 14 -> Model 1-8) only changed names. The Photorealistic section (photoreal-1 = old model-2, photoreal-2) was removed on 2026-10-19; those ids and #model-2 now fall back to the first model. The Generated section (generated-1, -2, -3) was removed on 2026-10-21: those ids fall back to the first model, except #generated-3/<outfit>, which opens Model 2 (exact-6, the same woman) in that outfit when she has it (outfitAliases).

outfitAliases._note: removed id -> model that keeps its outfits; used only when the link names an outfit that model has
